# R for BioData Science - Group 7 - Project

### Downloading the data

The data used in this project is from :

https://www.cbioportal.org/study/clinicalData?id=tmb_mskcc_2018 

After having cloned the repository, the raw data needs to be downloaded in order to run the project. 
To do so:
- download all clinical and genomic data of this study.
- create a data folder in the project folder
- create a _raw folder in the data folder
- in the _raw folder, upload the following files
  - data_clinical_patient.txt
  - data_clinical_sample.txt
  - data_gene_panel_matrix.txt
  - data_mutations.txt
  - data_sv.txt
